## About
Sourav Sarker (Suvro) is a full-stack developer specializing in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AI-assisted product workflows. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh; works with UK and US clients.

## Services
- Web application design and development
- Landing pages and dashboards
- AI chatbot and agent desk integrations
- Business growth tools (copy, SEO, ICP, pricing)
